sources.title: New technique helps robots pack objects into a tight space
sources.snippet: Professors Leslie Kaelbling, Tomas Lozano-Perez, and Josh Tenenbaum are members of a team of MIT researchers who used a form of generative AI, called a diffusion model, to solve packing problems more efficiently. Their method uses a collection of machine-learning models, each of which is trained to represent one specific type of constraint.

sources.title: Packing Perfection: MIT Uses Generative AI To Reshape ... - SciTechDaily
sources.snippet: The technique uses diffusion models to find optimal solutions, outperforming traditional methods, and shows promise for future applications in a variety of environments. Researchers coaxed a family of generative AI models to work together to solve multistep robot manipulation problems.
